operations.name: quickfile_rest_invoice_post
operations.summary: Create a new invoice, estimate or recurring invoice template

type.description: Type of document. E.g. invoice, estimate, recurring.

client_contact_name.description: Contact name to appear on the invoice. Omit node to apply default contact for the client.

client_address.description: Supply a different client address to overide the default. Omit node to apply default address on file.

client_country.description: Client ISO 3166 Country Code. 2 characters long.

currency.description: Currency ISO code must be 3 characters long.

discount_percentage.description: Optional discount percentage applied to invoice total.

term_days.description: Number of days permitted to pay the invoice.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code. Maximum 2 characters long.

description.description: A brief description of the invoice raised. If not supplied will assume the description of the first invoice item/task. Between 2-35 characters long.

notes.description: Additional notes to appear on invoice.

ec_vat_exempt.description: Legacy pre-Brexit EC VAT flag. Do not use.

invoice_number.description: If invoice number is not supplied the system will auto-increment. Between 1 and 20 characters long

vat_codes.description: Possible codes: exempt (VAT Exempt), oos (VAT Out of Scope), cisrc (CIS Reverse Charge), nisogs (EU supply of goods), niserv (EU supply of services).

tags.description: Provide up to 5 additional project tags

item_lines.description: Use for products and services priced using the quantity and unit cost model.

vat_rate.description: The VAT rate to be applied. For non-VAT Reg suppliers use 0.00

vat_amount.description: Overrides the VAT Rate for specific VAT amounts. If missing will be calculated from the rate.

task_lines.description: Use for itemising elements charged on an hourly rate at a fixed amount per hour.

vat_amount.description: Optional tax element to be levied on the item. Between 1 and 7 characters long

dd_delay.description: Specify the number of days delay you would like to add before initiating a Direct Debit collection. Between 0 and 60
